# Model Card

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ModelCard`](gmeow-ModelCard.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ModelCard>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A structured description of a model agent ([`gmeow:describesModel`](../properties/gmeow-describesModel.md)): provider, version tag, context window, training cutoff. Aligns Model Cards / ML-Schema / SPDX-AI by reference (P5). The card is a document ABOUT the agent; capability claims are claim-layer observations, attributed and contestable.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ModelCard`](gmeow-ModelCard.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the structured document describing a model agent — provider, version tag, context window, training cutoff; the information object ABOUT the [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) uses.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with the model itself (the agent is the [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md), the card is a document about it) and avoid baking capability claims into the card as facts — those are attributed, contestable claim-layer observations.

### How to use

- Type the description [`gmeow:ModelCard`](gmeow-ModelCard.md), link it to the agent with [`gmeow:describesModel`](../properties/gmeow-describesModel.md), and carry the declared facets ([`gmeow:modelProvider`](../properties/gmeow-modelProvider.md), [`gmeow:modelVersionTag`](../properties/gmeow-modelVersionTag.md), [`gmeow:modelContextWindow`](../properties/gmeow-modelContextWindow.md), [`gmeow:modelTrainingCutoff`](../properties/gmeow-modelTrainingCutoff.md)); keep capability assertions as separate attributed claims.

### Examples

- ex:opusCard a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](gmeow-ModelCard.md); [`gmeow:describesModel`](../properties/gmeow-describesModel.md) ex:opus; [`gmeow:modelProvider`](../properties/gmeow-modelProvider.md) "Anthropic"; [`gmeow:modelTrainingCutoff`](../properties/gmeow-modelTrainingCutoff.md) "2026-01-01"^^[xsd:date.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date.)
